instruction: Please show me how to configure VS Code to display a dynamic background that changes based on the time of day.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because time-based dynamic backgrounds are not a native VS Code feature and would require custom extensions with time-tracking and conditional image loading logic. Verification would need to check the current time and confirm the appropriate background is displayed, which involves complex time-dependent logic beyond state-based evaluation capabilities.
metadata.infeasible_reason: Time-based dynamic backgrounds require extensions and time-dependent verification logic

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - time-based dynamic backgrounds require continuous monitoring of time and corresponding background changes
OSWorld's evaluation framework is designed for static state verification, not dynamic time-dependent behavior
No available getter/metric functions can verify that a background changes automatically based on time of day
The feature requires custom extensions with complex time-tracking logic that cannot be verified through static state checking
The infeasible classification appropriately recognizes that verification would require waiting for time to pass or simulating different times, which is beyond the framework's capabilities
